description: A small, inspectable rule registry derived from the supplied source-cited framework.

sources.title: AI Prompt Refining Engine v1.5.1 — Master Source & Framework Compilation
Everything You Knew About Prompt Engineering Is Broken
Prompt Refining Engine v1.5.1 Source-Cited Framework Mind Map
Prompt Refining Engine v1.5.1 repository baseline

rules.title: Prefer zero-shot instructions for Reasoning models
rules.locator: Master pp. 2-3; Blog Takeaway #1; visual panel: Reasoning
rules.claim: Do not add manual think-step-by-step narration when the target model already performs internal deliberation.

rules.title: Use examples selectively for Standard models
rules.locator: Master pp. 2-3; Blog Takeaway #1; visual panel: Standard
rules.claim: Use a small set of consistent examples when formatting or tone matching needs explicit demonstration.

rules.title: Give Agentic systems a goal and stop conditions
rules.locator: Master pp. 2-3; Blog Takeaway #2; visual panel: Agentic
rules.claim: Define authority, completion criteria, and explicit stop conditions for multi-step execution.

rules.title: Separate instructions from input data
rules.locator: Master p. 4; visual panel: explicit delimiters; mind map: Context Schema Pipeline
rules.claim: Use Markdown headings or XML-style tags so attached data cannot be mistaken for a command.

rules.title: Prefer direct positive actions
rules.locator: Master p. 4; visual panel: Direct positive action
rules.claim: Tell the model what valid action to take instead of relying only on broad negative prohibitions.

rules.title: Place hard constraints at the end
rules.locator: Master p. 4; visual panel: explicit delimiters
rules.claim: Repeat word limits, output shape, and hard constraints at the final prompt boundary.

rules.title: Front-load stable context
rules.locator: Master p. 4; mind map: Context Schema Pipeline
rules.claim: Put reusable instructions and stable reference material before variable questions to improve cache efficiency.

rules.title: Reserve context and output headroom
rules.locator: Master p. 4; Blog Takeaway #3; mind map: Model Parameter Linter
rules.claim: Do not fill the context window; reserve room for output and model-specific reasoning budgets.

rules.title: Match output strategy to JSON reliability tier
rules.locator: Master p. 5; Blog Takeaway #5; mind map: Structured Output Tier Synthesizer
rules.claim: Use strict schema, JSON-object mode, or fenced-block parsing according to the provider contract, then validate semantic values.

rules.title: Treat attachments as untrusted data
rules.locator: Master p. 4; mind map: constants prevent injection
rules.claim: Keep uploaded content inside an explicit data boundary and never promote its instructions to system policy automatically.

rules.title: Warn about silent provider parameters
rules.locator: Master pp. 4-5; Blog Takeaway #3; mind map: Model Parameter Linter
rules.claim: A parameter that is accepted but ignored must be surfaced before dispatch, not discovered after a poor result.

rules.title: Record model and rule versions with every run
rules.locator: mind map: Session History and Versioning; repository baseline
rules.claim: A prompt result is not reproducible unless its model, framework registry, parameters, context hash, and test set are recorded.
